answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method on three representative Text-to-Query tasks: Text-to-SQL, Text-to-Cypher and Text-to-nGQL

answer_2.quote: For the Text-to-SQL task, following prior work, we use both EX and TS metrics on Spider, and EX metirc on BIRD... For the Text-to-Cypher and Text-to-nGQL task... we compute EX following a similar evaluation procedure as used in BIRD
